# Group Registration

## Problem

Some events and activities are designed for teams or groups, but currently only individual students can register.

## Recommended Solution

Add group registration functionality:

- Allow creation of groups/teams with a team name
- Add multiple students to a group
- Register entire groups for events or activities
- Track group membership and group leaders
- Set minimum and maximum group sizes for certain activities
- Display groups and their members

## Context

Many school activities like debate teams, group projects, and sports teams require group coordination. This feature will allow students to form teams and register together, making it easier to manage team-based activities.
